title: Executive-as-a-Service (EaaS)
subtitle: Capital is a commodity. Senior executive leadership capable of navigating regulatory complexity, security architecture, and organizational scaling is scarce.

sections.heading: The Competence Investment Thesis:
sections.body: Attolloo contributes senior executive capacity (CEO governance, CSO risk architecture, HR Director leadership) in exchange for equity or performance-based revenue share — without deploying dilutive capital.

sections.heading: Engagement Roles:
sections.body:
* Board Member: `Strategic direction, investor relations, and EMV decision frameworks.`

* Strategic Adviser: `Framework deployment (Polaris 90-day sprints, 6Sense evaluation).`

* Operative Partner: `Hands-on leadership in critical transition periods (interim CEO/CSO/HR).`
